content.value: A flexible manufacturing system (FMS) is being planned. It has a ladder layout as picture in Fig. It uses a rail guided vehicle (RGV) system to move parts between situations in the layout. All work parts are loaded into the system at station 1, move to 1 of three processing stations (2, 3 or 4) and then brought back to station 1 for unloading. Once loaded on to its RGV, each workpart stays on board the vehicle throughout its time the FMS. Load and unload times at staion 1 are each 1.0 min. Processing time are: 5.0 min at station 2; 7.0 min at station 3; and 9 min at station 4. Hourly production of parts through the system is : 7 parts through station 2; 6 parts through station 3; and 5 parts through station 4. Now determine-
(i) Develop the from-to chart for trips and distances;

(iii) Determine the number of rail guided vehicle that are needed to meet the requiremnts of the flexible manufacturing system, if vehicle speed=60 m/min and the anticipated traffic factor=0.85. assume reliability= 100%

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2021
